package.name: racer_control
package.description: C++ pure-pursuit raceline-tracking controller (roadmap task S.2, claude-docs/04-architecture.md): tracker_node subscribes /odom and publishes /drive_raw at 50 Hz using a curvature-adaptive-lookahead pure pursuit controller over a committed raceline (config/tracks/<venue>_<layout>/raceline.csv, generated by tools/raceline). Core control logic (include/racer_control/) is ROS-free and gtest-unit-tested per claude-docs/12-testing.md L1.
